name: Zojirushi Corporation
summary: Zojirushi Corporation manufactures and markets household products in Japan and internationally. The company offers rice cooker; microwave oven; kitchen appliances, including hot plate, toaster oven, electric cooking pot, grill pan, multi roaster, coffee maker, blender/juicer, tabletop IH cooking heater, home bakery, mochi pounding machine, dish dryer, and other kitchen supplies; pots and kettles; household appliances, such as humidifier, futon dryer, and air purifier; water bottles and tumblers; lunch box; and commercial products, including soup jar and cookware, electric rice cooker, chocolate warmer, electric pot/kettle, humidifiers and air purifiers, pot cool pitcher, vacuum drink dispens…
